comment: Add these to your existing package.json
comment2: The 'scripts' section should be merged into your existing scripts, not replace them

scripts_to_add.generate:batch:validate: npm run validate:content && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint

steps.description: Open package.json and find the 'scripts' section
Add these 3 lines to your scripts section
additions: "generate:batch:validate": "npm run validate:content && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint"

what_if_it_already_has_different_scripts.explanation: Your existing 'scripts' section already has 'web', 'android', 'ios', 'lint', etc.
what_if_it_already_has_different_scripts.instruction: Just ADD the 3 generate:batch lines to that section. Don't remove or replace anything.
